resources.string: Code: letters for full pinyin, digits for nine-key

One phrase, code and optional integer weight per line, separated by tabs. Use Add phrase to insert a row. Full pinyin and nine-key share this file; a letter code and a numeric code are separate entries. Import replaces this list after creating a recovery backup.
Enter a phrase and code without tabs or line breaks. A phrase cannot start with #.
Replace this dictionary with its most recent recovery backup? The current dictionary will also be backed up. This restores records exactly; importing a Rime snapshot merges records instead.
Merge a Rime user dictionary snapshot
